---
title: "Pain Medicine Learning Modules"
---

Welcome to the Pain Medicine Learning Modules website!

<p>Pain Medicine Learning Modules is an educational website for medical students, residents, and other interested learners who want to explore topics in pain medicine. This project is developed by McMaster medical students with an interest in making pain medicine learning practical and accessible.</p>
<p>The site has a particular focus on back pain, combining foundational concepts with practical approaches to assessment, investigation, and management. The modules are designed to support clear, clinically relevant learning that can be revisited at a learner's own pace.</p>
